Eli (AE): Need an exec unblock for CtoBank. Two blockers: firm SLA for sustained 1k TPS window and BYO-KMS + Okta SSO security signoff. Can we do a 9am PST bridge tomorrow?
Nia (SE): I can join. Whats the token mix? avg tokens/request?
Eli (AE): CTO says ~110 tokens/request average, sustained bursts of ~25-35 minutes.
Rahul (Infra): For sustained 1k TPS we should provision dedicated pool. Need their peering CIDR and expected daily egress.
Luz (CS): I have their CISO and Leila (CTO) on standby for the bridge. Scheduling once we confirm docs.
Priya (Legal): BYO-KMS requires a DPA addendum and explicit key custody terms. Also request SOC2 and subprocessor list.
Marco (Finance): Rough pricing sketch: dedicated POC nodes + support = $16k/mo pro-rata; BYO-KMS integration = $5k one-time; SLA uplift = $3.2k/mo, min 3-month commitment.
Nia (SE): Uploading short arch note + curl snippet for Okta auth and KMIP flow.
ops-bot: Reminder: attach presales checklist and create folder /sales/presales/ctobank-unblock.
Priya (Legal): Ill draft DPA redline and KMS clause; need their legal contact. ETA 6 hours.
Rahul (Infra): Well run a quick staging perf test tonight to validate p99. Will post numbers ASAP.
Eli (AE): Action list: Nia finalize doc + cost breakout EOD, Rahul run perf and confirm SLO runbook, Priya prepare redline, Marco lock term. Kai (CS) to send invite once DPA draft uploaded.
Eli (AE): Closing for now, will ping when invite is live. If anything blocks, @channel.
__comment: Internal sales exec escalation thread: POC blockers (SLA, BYO-KMS, Okta SSO, pricing), scheduling an exec bridge and action items.
